sources_considered.why: The primary S-1 filed October 26, 2026 returned HTTP 403, so it could not be read.
A detailed reproduction of the S-1's quarterly income statement, with GAAP and adjusted lines separated.
A social media summary of the same figures.
Covers a September leak, not the filed S-1.

receipt.public_excerpt: First quarterly operating profit in the periods presented (Q1 2025 to Q2 2026): $974m in Q2 2026, 8.4% margin; adjusted operating income $2.2bn (19%).

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic's unadjusted operating income in Q2 2026 was a $974 million profit, separate from the larger 'adjusted' $2.2 billion. Making an operating profit before any adjustments goes against 'not profitable outside of financial engineering' for the quarter containing the post.

receipt.public_excerpt: Net loss 6M 2026 $80.7bn, of which $72.4bn is a non cash fair value change on convertible notes, derivative liabilities and SAFEs.

evidence_items.explanation: On a GAAP net basis, Anthropic was deeply unprofitable in the first half of 2026. The S-1 table puts the Q2 net loss at $66.3 billion. This supports 'not profitable', although most of the loss is a non-cash revaluation of financing instruments.

receipt.public_excerpt: Operating cash flow turned positive: $3.9bn in 6M 2026 against ($1.5bn); capex $482m; derived free cash flow $3.4bn.

evidence_items.explanation: Cash from operations was positive in the first half of 2026. This is context on whether the business generated cash apart from financing.

unresolved_gaps: The primary S-1 on EDGAR could not be read (HTTP 403). Figures come from a detailed third-party reproduction of its tables.
The speaker did not define 'financial engineering'. It is unclear whether he would count elements such as cloud-partner arrangements inside operating income.
For the first half of 2026 as a whole, operating income was still a loss of $693 million.
